name: ReviewAnchorBench
description: ReviewAnchorBench is an executable benchmark and replication package for evaluating revision-aware mapping of code review suggestions. Version 1.1.0 extends the published 1.0.0 package with a calibration-repository-disjoint population-sampled stratum of 300 anchors and 3,000 deterministic transformation cases, direct dual-anchor component ablations, selective-risk analyses, and calibration-matched CodeMapper comparisons. It also preserves the 653-anchor hard-challenge benchmark and its 6,530 transformation cases. The archive includes frozen inputs, code, results, checksums, verification tools, and offline reconstruction instructions. Third-party source files are redistributed only where their licenses permit; otherwise, exact repository, commit, path, size, and SHA-256 bindings support verified retrieval.
